greeting: Egameni likaYise, neloNyana, neloMoya oyiNgcwele. Makube noxolo lwakwaThixo nenceba yakhe kuni nonke.
penitential: Nkosi, sihawukele. Kristu, sihawukele. Nkosi, sihawukele.
homily:
Kukho imizuzu apho ubomi bujongeka njengomzamo wokufunda imephu kwindawo esingayaziyo. Sonke sibe apho—sijonga iindlela, sizama ukufumana indlela eya ekhaya, okanye mhlawumbi sizama ukufumana indlela eya kuye umntu esimkhumbulayo. Benjamin Vo wayeyinkwenkwe eyayithanda ukufunda iimephu, hayi nje iimephu zokuhamba, kodwa iimephu zokwakha ikamva. Wayeyindoda encinci eyayithanda ukubukela iinqwelo-moya zihamba kwiindlela zazo zomoya, ecinga ngale 'con chim airlines' yakhe, encuma xa ethetha ngayo. Ben wayengumfana owayenengqondo eqaqambileyo, umfana owayesazi ukuba indlela eya phambili ifuna ukuzimisela, ukuzama, kunye nokukholwa. Namhlanje, kwiVangeli, uYesu usinika imephu yobomi bethu bonke. Akasixeleli ngeenqwelo-moya okanye ngeekhowudi zekhompyutha, kodwa usixelela ngento enye ebalulekileyo: uthando. 'Uze uthande iNkosi uThixo wakho ngentliziyo yakho yonke, nangomphefumlo wakho wonke, nangengqondo yakho yonke.' Le yindlela yokuphila, le yindlela yokufumana uxolo.

Khumbula lo mfanekiso: Ben, eneminyaka elishumi nanhlanje, efuna ukunikela ngayo yonke imali yakhe yasebhange encinci ukunceda umalume wakhe uWilliam owayehlaselwe yimivumbo. Wayengazange ayiphule loo ngulube yemali, yayingekho imfuneko yokuba ayiphule ngenxa yokuba umalume wayene-inshurensi. Kodwa loo mnikelo wangoqobo, lowo mbono womntwana owayezimiseleyo ukunikela ngako konke okwakhe ngaphandle kokubala, usixelela ukuba uBen wayenesipho esikhulu sothando olungenamiqathango. Loo mnikelo wawungumfanekiso wothando lukaKristu olungaphezulu kolwazi. UBen wayengumfana owayengalindi ukuba izinto zenzeke; wayeyindoda encinci eyayithatha inyathelo lothando ngaphandle kokuzigcina nto. Loo ntliziyo yayicocekile, ingaphili ngemithetho yobuxoki yeli hlabathi, kodwa iphila ngenceba kaThixo. UBen wayengumfana owayethanda ukunika, owayethanda ukuba nomdla kwabanye, owayesoloko enoncumo olwaluthi, 'Ndikhona, ndiyakuthanda.' UBen wayengumfana owayewazi umthetho omkhulu kwaye wawuphila ngendlela yakhe ethuleyo kodwa enamandla.

Kodwa Alan, Thao, nawe Ryan mfowethu omncane, ndiyazi ukuba kule minyane minne idlulileyo ukususela ngowe-13 kuJuni 2026, iintlungu ziza ngamanye amaxesha ngendlela embi kakhulu. Kukho amandla emphefumlo aphelileyo, kukho ubusuku obude lapho ukungabikho kwesitulo sikaBen okanye ukungaphulaphuli kwakhe amabanga ayethethwa nguyise kubangela isikhewu esingazalisekiyo. Kodwa mamela le nyaniso namhlanje: uThixo akamlibalanga uBen, kwaye akakubalelanga nani. Kwizinto ezenzekayo ebudeni bokugula, abazali abaninzi bazithwala ngokwabo umthwalo wokuzisola: 'Ngaba kukhona endinokukwenza ngcono? Ngaba ndiphosile?' Mamele kakuhle, Alan noThao: uThixo akakubeki icala. UBen akakubeki icala. Ezo zifo aziziswanga zizinto owazenzayo okanye ongazenzanga. Kweli hlabathi, kukho izinto ezenzeka ngaphandle kolawulo lomntu, ngaphandle kwempazamo yomzali. Awuphosanga nto. Uthando lwakho lwalucocekile, lwaluphelele, kwaye uBen wayesazi ukuba unothando olungaka kubazali bakhe nakuRyan. Khipha elo litye lokuzisola ezintliziyweni zenu namhlanje. UBen akajongi iziphoso; ujonge phezulu kuThixo, kwaye uqhubeka esithi kuwe: 'Ba, Mama, musani ukukhala kakhulu, ndikhuselekile.'

KwiNcwadi yeDuteronomi, uThixo uthi: 'Uze ungamphathi kakubi umfokazi, kuba nani naba ngabafokazi eYiputa.' UThixo ukhusela ababuthathaka, ukhusela abafelokazi kunye neenkedama. UThixo uyayiva intliziyo yakho xa ikhala. UYesu, kwiVangeli, uqinisekisa lo myalelo ngokuthi: 'Uze uthande ummelwane wakho njengoko uzithanda wena.' UBen wayengummelwane onjalo—umntu owayesazi ukuba ukuthanda umntu akukho malunga nokuba unantoni, kodwa malunga nokuba ungubani. UBen wayeyindoda encinci eyayikwazi ukubona ukuba ubomi buphila ngothando, hayi ngezinto eziphathekayo. Xa uRyan ecinga ngemidlalo yenu, ngale roller coaster enayikhwela ngeziganeko ezimnandi, yazi ukuba uBen akakushiye. Ukhona ecaleni kwakho, eqhubeka ekusebenza njengesikhokelo sothando. UBen wayengumfana owayenenqgondo enkulu yezibalo ne-AI, kodwa ikratshi lakhe elikhulu kwakuwukuba ngumntwana omhle owayehlonipha abazali bakhe. UBen uya kuhlala ekukhuthaza, nangona ungamboni ngamehlo, kodwa uya kumva entliziyweni yakho. Uthando lwenu njengabazalwana luyinto engunaphakade.

Masithathe oku namhlanje: uBen wasishiya isipho sothando esingapheliyo. Kwisikhumbuzo sabangcwele abasifundisa ukuba nibe nesibindi sokuma ngenxa kaKristu, masime nathi namhlanje siqinisekile ukuba ubomi bukaBen abuphelanga ethuneni. Usemthekweni wasezulwini, apho i-'con chim airlines' yakhe ibhabha ngokuphakamileyo phambi kobuso bukaThixo. Hamba ke namhlanje uphumle, uthembe ukuba uThixo uyakuthanda, kwaye uBen ulinda wena ngoncumo lwakhe oluqhelekileyo. UBen akakho nje kwimbali yenu; ukwikhona apho uThixo enza khona yonke into ibe ntsha. Uthando lwakho, Ben, lusaqhubeka luhamba emhlabeni, lusaqhubeka lukhanya, kwaye lusaqhubeka lukhumbuza wonke umntu okwaziyo ukuba uThixo uyamthanda umntwana wakhe ngaphezu kwayo yonke into. Hlalani neli themba. Hlalani nolu thando. UBen ukhona, uyaqhubeka, kwaye uya kuhlala ephila kuthando lukaThixo olungapheliyo. Amen.
spiritual_communion: Nkosi yam uYesu, ndiyakholwa ukuba ukhona kule Sakramente. Ndiyakuthanda ngaphezu kwako konke, kwaye ndinqwenela ukukwamkela emphefumlweni wam. Ekubeni ndingenako ngoku ukukwamkela kwiSakramente, nceda uze kum ngomoya. Ndiyakwamkela ngathi sele ukhona, ndimanyane nawe ngokupheleleyo. Ungaze undivumele ndahluke kuwe. Amen.
closing: Ngamana uThixo onamandla angakubusisa, akugcine, kwaye akukhanyisele ngoxolo lwakhe olungenasiphelo. Amen.
standing_petitions: Sithandazela uBen kunye nabo bonke abangasekhoyo, ukuze baphumle ngokuthula kukhanya lukaKristu.
Sithandazela bonke abalilayo, ukuze uThixo abathuthuzele kwaye abaphe ithemba elingapheliyo.

readings.label: Isifundo sokuqala
readings.text: Utsho uYehova uthi: 'Musa ukumphatha kakubi umfokazi, okanye umcinezele, kuba nani naba ngabafokazi elizweni laseYiputa. Musa ukumphatha kakubi umhlolokazi okanye inkedama. Ukuba uthe waphatha kakubi, wakhala kuye, ndiya kuwuva ngokuqinisekileyo umkhala wakhe. Umsindo wam uya kuvutha, ndikubulale ngekrele; abafazi benu baya kuba ngabahlolokazi, abantwana benu babe ziinkedama. Ukuba uboleke imali komnye wamahlwempu akuthi, musa ukumphatha njengomcinezeli ngokumcela inzala. Ukuba uthe wathatha ingubo yommelwane wakho njengesibambiso, uze uyibuyisele kuye phambi kokutshona kwelanga; kuba le ngubo yiyo yodwa anayo yokugquma umzimba wakhe. Angalala ngantoni ke? Ukuba uthe wakhala kuye, ndiya kuva; kuba ndinenceba.'

readings.label: Indumiso
readings.text: R. Ndiyakuthanda, Nkosi, mandla am. Ndiyakuthanda, Yehova, mandla am, Yehova, liliwa lam, inqaba yam, nomsindisi wam. R. Ndiyakuthanda, Nkosi, mandla am. Thixo wam, liliwa lam lokuzimela, ikhaka lam, uphondo losindiso lwam, inqaba yam ephakamileyo! Ndiyamemeza ndithi: Makadunyiswe uYehova, ndize ndisindiswe kubutshaba bam. R. Ndiyakuthanda, Nkosi, mandla am. UYehova uyaphila, malidunyiswe iliwa lam! Makaphakanyiswe uThixo, uMsindisi wam. Wena owanika ukunqoba okukhulu kukumkani wakho, wambonisa inceba umthanjiswa wakho. R. Ndiyakuthanda, Nkosi, mandla am.

readings.label: Isifundo sesibini
readings.text: Bazalwana noodade: Niyazi ukuba sasinjani na phakathi kwenu ngenxa yenu. Nani naba ngabaxelisi bethu nabayeNkosi, ilizwi nalamkela kwiimbandezelo ezininzi, kunye novuyo oluvela kuMoya oyiNgcwele, kangangokuba naba ngumzekelo kubo bonke abakholwayo kwelaseMakedoniya nakwela-Akaya. Kuba ilizwi leNkosi livakale kuni, kungekhona nje eMakedoniya nase-Akaya, kodwa ukukholwa kwenu kuThixo kuye kwavakala kuyo yonke indawo, kangangokuba asinakuthetha nto. Kuba bona ngokwabo babalisa ngathi, ukuba samkelwa njani na nini, nendlela enaguquka ngayo kuThixo, nashiya izithixo, ukuze nikhonze uThixo ophilayo nowokwenyaniso, nilinde uNyana wakhe esezulwini, amvusa kwabafileyo, uYesu, osindisayo kumsindo ozayo.

readings.label: IVangeli
readings.text: Bakuvayo abaFarisi ukuba uYesu ubathulisile abaSadusi, bahlanganisana, omnye wabo, umfundi womthetho, wamlinga ngokubuza wathi: 'Mfundisi, nguwuphi umthetho omkhulu emthethweni?' Wathi kuye: 'Uze uthande iNkosi uThixo wakho ngentliziyo yakho yonke, nangomphefumlo wakho wonke, nangengqondo yakho yonke. Lo ngumthetho omkhulu nowokuqala. Owesibini uyafana nawo: Uze uthande ummelwane wakho njengoko uzithanda wena. Wonke umthetho nabaprofeti kuxhomekeke kule mithetho mibini.'

pet_prayers.text: Thinking of you buddy! Stop by to say hello whenever you can okay? Love you Ben

pet_prayers.name: Dad
pet_prayers.text: Hey Ben - Been dreaming about you a lot. Hope you're having fun up in heaven. Please look after our family. Remember to come say hi daily. We miss you so much!

Ben ơi, trong giấc ngủ anh Huy đã thấy Ben về thăm anh, trao cho anh lời cầu nguyện để hai anh em mình lại được tìm thấy nhau. Xin Chúa thương nhậm lời Ben, cho Ben được hưởng ngàn thu bình an bên Chúa. Nếu có thể, xin Ben lại ghé thăm anh trong những giấc mơ tiếp theo nhé, dù chỉ là một lời chào hay một nụ cười thân thương như ngày nào.

pet_prayers.name: Dad
pet_prayers.text: Ben, my sweet boy, I miss you so much. Thank you for visiting me and Chú Chris last night. He told me he saw you flying a helicopter—so free, joyful, and strong up there. Down here, Mom and I are crying more and more each day. A piece of my heart feels completely dead without you, Ben. Please watch over us, pray for your mom, your brother Ryan, and me, and give us the strength to keep going. We love you forever

pet_prayers.name: Dad
pet_prayers.text: Today marks 100 days without you. Miss you a whole a lot Ben. Feel free to visit any time! See you around buddy! Love you!

Ben ơi, nay anh M đi xử lý hồ sơ ở Cam Ranh, đi ngang qua Cam Ranh Airport. Rồi cuộc nói chuyện về máy bay của Ben lại ùa về, nhớ nhiều kỷ niệm về Ben lắm ( anh M sẽ giữ kín kakaka). Quỷ nhỏ, tự nhiên nghĩ về mày buồn dễ sợ. Hãy đi đến những nơi mà Ben muốn nha và đừng quên là luôn nhớ về gia đình mình nhé, thương em trai nhiều. Giá như !!!!!!!!!

pet_prayers.name: Dad
pet_prayers.text: What happened my son? It's been 3 months since you left us. Missing you so much my whole body aches. Mom cries every day now... What are we going to do now Ben?  Please pray for us.
